roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Sets up the workspace: master data, users, roles and controls. Full access.

roles.name: CEO
roles.description: Runs the company. Sees every number and is the final approver.

roles.name: CTO
roles.description: Owns delivery and technology across all projects, without company finance.

roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Plans and delivers projects, assigns and reviews the team’s work.

roles.name: HR Manager
roles.description: Owns people operations: onboarding, leave, appraisals, payroll preparation and procurement.

roles.name: HR Executive
roles.description: Day-to-day HR: onboards employees, records leave, runs recruitment. Sensitive changes go to the HR Manager.

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Runs the sales team and the whole pipeline.

roles.name: Sales Executive
roles.description: Works their own deals and clients.

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Self-service: tasks, timesheets, leave, expenses, documents and appraisal.

approval_workflows.name: Leave approval
approval_workflows.description: The reporting manager (or their delegate) decides leave.

approval_workflows.name: Expense claim approval
approval_workflows.description: Project manager (or reporting manager) approves; claims above ₹25,000 also need the CEO.

approval_workflows.name: Purchase order approval
approval_workflows.description: Every purchase order is approved by the CEO before it is issued.

approval_workflows.name: Vendor bill approval
approval_workflows.description: The CEO approves vendor bills for payment.

approval_workflows.name: Timesheet approval
approval_workflows.description: Weekly timesheets are approved by the reporting manager.

approval_workflows.name: Task review
approval_workflows.description: Submitted tasks are reviewed by the task reviewer (PM, or the assigning manager).

wf_templates.name: Annual appraisal
wf_templates.description: Employee self-appraisal → manager / TL review → unit head review → HR review → finance approval. On approval the appraisal letter is generated and emailed, and the new CTC goes to Cost rates for a checker.

stages.name: Employee self-appraisal
stages.instructions: Rate yourself honestly against your goals and the competencies. Give examples — your manager sees the same delivery data.

fields.label: Key achievements
fields.help: What you delivered and the impact it had.

fields.label: Development needs
fields.help: Skills, training or exposure you want next.

stages.name: Manager / TL review
stages.instructions: Rate each parameter on evidence from the period. Your private comments go to HR only — the employee, unit head and finance never see them.

stages.name: Unit head review
stages.instructions: Calibrate across your unit. Endorse the manager’s recommended hike or modify it.

fields.label: Endorsed hike
fields.help: Same as the manager’s unless you modify it.

stages.name: HR review
stages.instructions: Check the pay band, normalise the hike across the company and set the outcome.

fields.label: New designation
fields.help: Leave empty to keep the current designation.

stages.name: Finance approval
stages.instructions: Approve the hike. Going above HR’s normalised hike needs a written reason.

fields.label: Reason for exceeding the normalised hike

doc_templates.description: Offer of employment with CTC, joining date, probation and notice period.
doc_templates.body:
:::right
Ref: {{ref_no}}
Date: {{today}}
:::

**{{employee_name}}**
{{employee_email}}

## Offer of employment — {{offer_designation}}

Dear {{employee_first_name}},

We are pleased to offer you the position of **{{offer_designation}}** in the {{department}} team at {{company}}. This letter sets out the main terms of our offer.

| Term | Detail |
|---|---|
| Designation | {{offer_designation}} |
| Department | {{department}} |
| Reporting to | {{manager_name}} |
| Work location | {{location}} |
| Proposed joining date | {{proposed_joining_date}} |
| Annual cost to company (CTC) | {{ctc_annual}} |
| Monthly CTC | {{ctc_monthly}} |
| Probation | {{probation_months}} months |
| Notice period | {{notice_period_days}} days |

### Conditions of this offer
- The offer is subject to satisfactory verification of your educational and employment documents.
- On your joining day, bring your PAN, Aadhaar, educational certificates, the relieving letter from your last employer and your last three payslips.
- Your detailed terms of employment, including leave and confidentiality obligations, are set out in your appointment letter.

Please confirm your acceptance by acknowledging this letter in SeereonOS on or before **{{offer_valid_until}}**, after which this offer lapses.

We look forward to welcoming you to {{company_brand}}.

Yours sincerely,

**{{signatory_name}}**
{{signatory_designation}}
For {{company}}

doc_templates.name: Appointment letter
doc_templates.description: Formal terms of employment: compensation, probation, leave, confidentiality and termination.
doc_templates.body:
:::right
Ref: {{ref_no}}
Date: {{today}}
:::

**{{employee_name}}**
Employee code: {{employee_code}}

## Letter of appointment

Dear {{employee_first_name}},

With reference to your acceptance of our offer, we are pleased to appoint you as **{{designation}}** at {{company}} with effect from **{{joining_date}}**, on the following terms and conditions.

### 1. Compensation
Your annual cost to company is **{{ctc_annual}}** ({{ctc_monthly}} per month), paid monthly in arrears to your registered bank account. Salary is paid for days covered by approved timesheets, in line with the company payroll policy.

### 2. Probation and confirmation
You will be on probation for {{probation_months}} months. On satisfactory completion you will be confirmed in writing. The company may extend probation once by up to three months.

### 3. Working hours and location
Your working hours are {{working_hours}}. Your place of work is {{location}}. You may be deputed to client sites or other locations as business requires.

### 4. Leave
You are entitled to leave as per the company leave policy in force, available under Documents → Policies.

### 5. Confidentiality and intellectual property
You will keep confidential all information about the company, its clients and its products, during and after your employment. All work you produce in the course of employment belongs to the company.

### 6. Notice period
Either party may end this appointment with {{notice_period_days}} days' written notice, or salary in lieu of notice.

### 7. Conduct
You will follow the company's code of conduct, policies and lawful instructions as amended from time to time.

Please acknowledge this letter in SeereonOS as your acceptance of these terms.

Yours sincerely,

**{{signatory_name}}**
{{signatory_designation}}
For {{company}}

doc_templates.description: Employee confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement for client work.
doc_templates.body:
:::right
Ref: {{ref_no}}
Date: {{today}}
:::

## Non-disclosure agreement

This agreement is made on **{{effective_date}}** between **{{company}}**, {{company_address}} (the "Company"), and **{{employee_name}}**, employee code {{employee_code}}, {{designation}} (the "Employee").

### 1. Confidential information
"Confidential information" means any non-public information about the Company, its clients, products, source code, designs, pricing, plans and personal data, whether written, electronic or oral.

### 2. Obligations
The Employee will:
- use confidential information only to perform their duties;
- not disclose it to anyone outside the Company without written permission;
- not copy client code or data to personal devices or accounts;
- return or delete all confidential information when their employment ends.

### 3. Term
These obligations apply during employment and for **{{term_years}} years** after it ends.

### 4. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of India. Courts in {{governing_city}} have exclusive jurisdiction.

| For the Company | Employee |
|---|---|
| {{signatory_name}} | {{employee_name}} |
| {{signatory_designation}} | {{designation}} |
| Date: {{today}} | Acknowledged in SeereonOS |
